# MenuBook

Namespace `Nfty.Ticket` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public record MenuBook
```

A CookBook flattened for runtime: every weight, rule and colorization, plus where the art is, and not one decoded pixel.

## Remarks

[`MenuBook.MenuSchemaVersion`](Nfty.Ticket.MenuBook.md#p-menuschemaversion) is named — and therefore written and read — as `menuSchemaVersion` rather than the plain `schemaVersion` a member called `SchemaVersion` would camelCase to. A Menu's schema line is separate from [`Schema`](Nfty.Core.Model.Schema.md), the CookBook manifest line, and a shared key name between two independently evolving formats is how one gets bumped and silently changes what the other means. Named this way deliberately rather than overridden with a `System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonPropertyName` attribute — no manifest record in this project carries a JSON attribute; the wire policy is supplied centrally (`Nfty.Core.Formats.Json.Options` on the write side, `MenuArchive.WireOptions` on the read side), and a property whose own name already produces the right key needs no exception to that rule.

## Constructors

### MenuBook(int, string?, Dimensions, string, string, IReadOnlyList&lt;MenuRecipe&gt;, MenuArt, bool) { #m-ctor-system-int32-system-string-nfty-core-model-dimens-e024a8 }

```csharp
public MenuBook(int MenuSchemaVersion, string? SourceCookBookSha256, Dimensions Canvas, string CollectionName, string CollectionSymbol, IReadOnlyList<MenuRecipe> Recipes, MenuArt Art, bool PartialAlpha = false);
```

**Parameters**

- `MenuSchemaVersion` (`int`) - The Menu schema this was written against.
- `SourceCookBookSha256` (`string?`) - The hash of the `.cbk` this came from, or null when it was built from a book that never came from a file. Null means "cannot tell", never "differs".
- `Canvas` (`Dimensions`) - The canvas every variant shares.
- `CollectionName` (`string`) - What assets are published as — `"{name} #{n}"`.
- `CollectionSymbol` (`string`) - The collection's symbol.
- `Recipes` (`IReadOnlyList<MenuRecipe>`) - Its recipes.
- `Art` (`MenuArt`) - Where the art is.
- `PartialAlpha` (`bool`) - Whether any variant image anywhere in the book carries partial alpha — the same definition `Nfty.Core.Imaging.Opacity` stamps onto every archive manifest, projected here so a runtime host can tell 2D-only art (safe to lift with depth maps alone) from art with a transparency gradient Rise cannot resolve, with no `.cbk` present. Defaults to `false` — schema 1 Menus are refused outright, so this default now matters only for a hand-written schema 2 manifest that omits the field; every Menu this build actually writes carries a real, stamped value.

## Methods

### CellKey(string, string, string) { #m-cellkey-system-string-system-string-system-string }

```csharp
public static string CellKey(string recipeId, string ingredientId, string variantId);
```

The key one variant's art is stored under.

**Parameters**

- `recipeId` (`string`) - The recipe the layer belongs to.
- `ingredientId` (`string`) - The layer.
- `variantId` (`string`) - The variant.

**Returns.** The cell key.

**Remarks**

**Scoped by RECIPE, and that is not redundancy.** A `.cbk` nests a separate `.igt` inside each `.rcp`, so two recipes may each carry an ingredient with the id `bg` holding completely different variants. A shallower key collides without a word and one recipe silently draws another's art.
